selection: Lowest development equal-four-cell image-macro MAE; include epoch 0 and break ties toward earlier epochs.
camera_coordinates: OpenCV resize half-pixel transform, integer letterbox padding; pinhole rays at P3 cell centers plus log normalized focal lengths.
control: Same trainable parameters and initialization as actual_camera; every image receives the fixed reference camera. This is an added-capacity control, not an unchanged original architecture.
loss: Same sparse raw-metre Huber in both arms: 0.8 equal available Vehicle/Pedestrian x 2-4/4-6 m cell means plus 0.2 broad 2-80 m, equal images within cells; delta 0.2 m.
training: Fresh AdamW for each arm, train existing depth decoder and residual adapter only; Urban body, detection head, corners and their BN statistics remain frozen.
range: Base exp(clamp(logZ,-4,5)) multiplied by exp(log(2)*tanh(residual)); correction in [0.5,2], no per-image scale fitting.
